## Source and reference material

[src/pi_secretary](../../src/pi_secretary/src/app.ts) contains the Core implementation; [src/pi_resource](../../src/pi_resource/README.md) is the pinned Pi submodule. [Internal fields](data/README.md) and the [database reference](database.md) are generated from schema/SQL. The API [schema](../api/v1/schema.json), [operation catalog](../api/v1/operations.json), and [OpenAPI](../api/v1/openapi.json) maintain the public contract separately. [Offline tests](test_case/offline/README.md), [online tests](test_case/online/README.md), and [reports](../../test_case/reports/README.md) organize validation separately.

[Fix plans](../fix/README.md) track current work; [past plans](../fix/archive/index.md), [API validation](../api/v1/verification.md), and [sync acceptance](../api/v1/issue9-verification.md) retain conclusions for their respective versions. The [original design](../old/README.md), [BrainStorm](../BrainStorm_Baseline_v3.md), and [retired SwiftUI design](../old/native-client-design-v0.3.md) provide historical context. See the [project README](../../README.md#roadmap) for the roadmap.
